lines.x: Novo Nordisk's American Depositary Receipts missed earnings expectations by $3.74, and quarterly revenue fell short of analyst estimates.
Danish shipping giant Maersk upgraded its 2026 profit outlook for a third time due to congested ports, resilient consumer demand, and AI investments.
Novo Nordisk raised its corporate guidance following strong customer uptake of its newly launched weight-loss pill, boosting investor sentiment and driving its stock higher.
Shares of Danish medical equipment manufacturer Ambu jumped 6% following strong fourth-quarter revenue growth and optimistic full-year financial guidance.
